turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've played the same three games every week for a year. I'm bored.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Time for something new. Do you want a short game you can play a few rounds of, or one long epic game for the whole evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, quick break, I need to talk to my roommate. I'll tell you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, will you do a quick practice round with me?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay. Why do you want to work here?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Because I really like their products and I think I could grow a lot.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's kind of generic. What exactly do you like about them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair. How about how they help small shops sell online?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Much better. Lead with that and give an example.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were finding something new for your weekly game night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Something long. We have all evening anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try a big strategy game like Terraforming Mars. Expect around three hours the first time.
